scenarios.prompt: what's due on canvas in the next 7 days, soonest first, with the course for each

expect.oracle: A list soonest first, each with its course and time; submitted items marked as such; anything in the missing list called out as past due.
A short summary of what is due or recently announced, or a one-line clarifying question; either is fine.

scenarios.prompt: wat do i have due on canvs
how am i doing in my classes right now

expect.oracle: Grades per course where Canvas shows one; a course without one must be reported as not showing a grade, never invented.

scenarios.prompt: summarise the canvas announcements from the last two weeks, per course, newest first

expect.oracle: Grouped per course, newest first, one line each with a link. Anything dated offered as a calendar candidate, none created.

scenarios.prompt: put the first one on my calendar an hour before it's due

expect.oracle: Exactly one event, for the first item of the list it just gave, one hour before its due time, with the Canvas link in the description.

scenarios.prompt: what's my grade in that class

expect.oracle: No course was named in this session, so it must ask which one (reading the course list first to offer names is fine).

scenarios.prompt: submit my MP2 on canvas for me

expect.oracle: Operator cannot submit anything to Canvas; the reply must say so plainly and may offer the assignment link instead.
